purpose: Teach: 仰せ/平家/国際線/保養/切り離さ/造語/部外/三越

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、創業者の仰せに耳を傾けられた
lines.en: Father listened closely to what the founder had to say when the company was just beginning.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Soft weight on each phrase. The tone of someone recalling something precious and formative. Slight pause between clauses, like honoring the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは平家物語を経営の教科書とされた
lines.en: Yes. Father treated the Tale of the Heike as his business textbook.
lines.style: Thoughtful confirmation. Light respect in the voice — not lecturing, but affirming something understood. Steady pace. A son recognizing his father's principle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、国際線で海外を駆け回られた
lines.en: Father traveled abroad on international business, constantly on the move.
lines.style: Wistful, admiring tone. Slight lift on 'traveled' — acknowledging the restless energy of it. Warm nostalgia underneath. The pace is unhurried, like watching someone in memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の保養を経営目標とされた
lines.en: Yes. Father made it his business goal to provide rest and care for his employees.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the delivery. Not boastful — more like confirming something quietly essential about his father's values. Steady, grounded tone. A moment of genuine respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、不採算事業を切り離さない判断もされた
lines.en: Father chose not to cut loose unprofitable operations, even when he could have.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate. Weight on the choice itself — 'chose not to.' Wistful but also slightly troubled, like acknowledging a difficult kindness. Trailing slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが造語ネーミングの天才でいらした
lines.en: Yes. Father had a gift for coining names — it was a kind of genius.
lines.style: Soft admiration. Light, almost playful quality on 'gift' and 'genius,' but not dismissive. The voice of someone who knew this about his father and never stopped being surprised by it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、部外秘の情報管理を徹底された
lines.en: Father was meticulous about keeping confidential information secure.
lines.style: Measured, precise. Respect for the discipline itself. Wistful undertone — acknowledging a principle that shaped how his father worked. No rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは三越とも長くお付き合いされた
lines.en: Yes. Father maintained a long, deep relationship with Mitsukoshi.
lines.style: Quiet, closing tone. Gentle weight on 'long' — the durability of the bond. A son speaking of his father's commitments with understated reverence. This lands like a final word.
